title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय २००

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कार्पासाचलमुत्तमम् ॥
परमं सर्वदानानां प्रियं सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kārpāsācalamuttamam ||
paramaṃ sarvadānānāṃ priyaṃ sarvadivaukasām || 1 ||

items.text:
देशकालौ समासाद्य धनं श्रद्धां च यत्नतः ॥
देयमेतन्महादानं कुलोद्धरणहेतवे ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
deśakālau samāsādya dhanaṃ śraddhāṃ ca yatnataḥ ||
deyametanmahādānaṃ kuloddharaṇahetave || 2 ||

items.text:
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन कृत्वा सर्वमशेषतः ॥
पर्वतं कल्पयेत्तत्र कार्पासेन विधानतः ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
pūrvoktena vidhānena kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ||
parvataṃ kalpayettatra kārpāsena vidhānataḥ || 3 ||

items.text:
विंशद्भारस्तु कर्तव्य उत्तमः पर्वतो बुधैः ॥
दशभिर्मध्यमः प्रोक्तो जघन्यः पंचभिर्मतः ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
viṃśadbhārastu kartavya uttamaḥ parvato budhaiḥ ||
daśabhirmadhyamaḥ prokto jaghanyaḥ paṃcabhirmataḥ || 4 ||

items.text:
तद्वज्जागरणं कुर्यात्तद्वच्चैवाधिवासनम् ॥
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यामिमं मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
tadvajjāgaraṇaṃ kuryāttadvaccaivādhivāsanam ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 6 ||

items.text:
त्वमेवावरणं यस्माल्लोकानामिह सर्वदा ॥
कार्पासाचल नस्तस्मादघौघध्वंसनो भव ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tvamevāvaraṇaṃ yasmāllokānāmiha sarvadā ||
kārpāsācala nastasmādaghaughadhvaṃsano bhava || 7 ||

items.text:
इति कार्पासशैलेन्द्रं यो दद्यात्पर्वसंनिधौ ॥
रुद्रलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततो राजा भवेदिह ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
iti kārpāsaśailendraṃ yo dadyātparvasaṃnidhau ||
rudraloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha || 8 ||

items.text:
रूपवान्सुभगो वाग्मी श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः ॥
पञ्चजन्मानि नारी वा जायते नात्र संशयः ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
rūpavānsubhago vāgmī śrīmānatulavikramaḥ ||
pañcajanmāni nārī vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||

items.text:
कार्पासपर्वतमयो जगदेकबंधुर्यस्मान्नतेन रहितो वरवस्त्रयोगः ॥
तस्मादघौधशमनाय सुखाय नित्यं देयो नरेण नरनाथविमत्सरेण ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
kārpāsaparvatamayo jagadekabaṃdhuryasmānnatena rahito varavastrayogaḥ ||
tasmādaghaudhaśamanāya sukhāya nityaṃ deyo nareṇa naranāthavimatsareṇa || 10 ||

items.h: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे कार्पासाचलदानविधिवर्णनं नाम द्विशततमोऽध्यायः ।। २०० ।।

en_summary: Krishna gives the cotton mountain (karpasa-achala), the best of all gifts and dear to all the gods, given at the right time and place, with wealth and faith, to lift up one's family. Following the earlier rite, a mountain of cotton is built: the best of twenty bharas, the middle ten and the least five, and one with little wealth may give one bhara, without stinting; everything is done as for the grain mountain, with the night vigil and consecration. At dawn the patron says: "Since you are always the covering of the worlds, cotton mountain, destroy our flood of sins." One who gives it at a festival lives a kalpa in Rudra's world and then becomes a handsome, fortunate, eloquent, rich king of matchless valour, or a woman likewise, for five births. Since the cotton mountain is the one friend of the world and there is no fine clothing without it, it should always be given, without envy, to calm sin and bring happiness.
